overview: Relational algebra ek procedural query language hai: select (sigma), project (pi), union, difference, cross product, rename, aur derived operators join, division. GATE me 4 kaam aate hain: expression ka output/tuple count, expression ka matlab, equivalence/optimization, aur 'for all' wali queries (division).
whyItMatters: 33 PYQs; 2014 se lagatar aaya hai (NAT tuple count + division-type MCQ).
coreConcept: Relations SETS hain (duplicates nahi). Har operator ek relation leta hai aur relation deta hai, isliye expressions ko nest kar sakte hain.
hinglishExplanation: sigma rows filter karta hai, pi columns chunta hai (aur duplicates hata deta hai). Join = cross product + condition. Division 'for all' ke liye hai: R / S un values ko deta hai jo S ki HAR row ke saath R me aati hain. 'Kabhi nahi mila' wale sawal difference (minus) se hote hain.
formalDefinition: sigma_c(R), pi_A(R), R U S, R - S, R x S, rho, R join_c S = sigma_c(R x S), R / S = pi_X(R) - pi_X((pi_X(R) x S) - R).
importantProperties: Union/intersection/difference ke liye relations union-compatible hone chahiye (same arity, same domains).
Projection duplicates hata deta hai, isliye output size <= input size.
Natural join: common attributes par equality, common columns ek baar. Common attribute na ho to cross product.
Join size: minimum 0 (koi match nahi), maximum |R| x |S| (jab join attribute ki value sab me same ho). Foreign key join me exactly |R| jitne (referencing side).
Selection commutative hai; sigma_{c1 and c2} = sigma_c1(sigma_c2). Selection ko join ke neeche push karna optimization hai.
Projection ko selection ke saath sirf tab swap kar sakte ho jab selection ke attributes projected hon.
Division: R(A,B) / S(B) = A values jo S ke sab B ke saath hain.
Outer joins me unmatched rows NULL ke saath aati hain; left outer join >= inner join size.
Basic algebra me recursion/transitive closure express NAHI ho sakta (e.g., path of any length).

formulas.fkJoin: FK -> PK join: |R join S| = |R| (no nulls)
formulas.division: R/S = pi_A(R) - pi_A((pi_A(R) x S) - R)

keyPropertiesAndIdentities: Selection push-down: sigma_c(R join S) = sigma_c(R) join S jab c sirf R ke attributes par ho.
commonPitfalls: Projection ke baad duplicates ka hat jaana bhool jaana.
Natural join me common attribute na hone par cross product ban jaana.
Set difference me order ka dhyaan (R - S != S - R).
standardTechniques: Tuples ki table banao aur operator ek ek karke chalao.
'Every / all' dekhe to division ya double negation (NOT EXISTS ...).
'Not / never' dekhe to difference use karo.
